title: feat(dialog): Mobile-first DialogContent with full-screen layout and WCAG touch targets
body:
Base `DialogContent` in `dialog.tsx` still used fixed centered positioning (`left-[50%] top-[50%]`), wasting viewport on mobile and leaving the close button at 16×16px. While `MobileDialogContent` already solved this for `ModalForm`, all other dialogs (command palette, import wizard, lookup fields, action dialogs, etc.) were unoptimized. ### Changes - **`packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx`** — Mobile-first `DialogContent`: - `inset-0 h-[100dvh]` on mobile → `sm:inset-auto sm:left-[50%] sm:top-[50%] sm:max-w-lg sm:h-auto sm:max-h-[90vh] sm:rounded-lg sm:border` on desktop - Close button: `min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]` touch target on mobile (WCAG 2.5.5), resets at `sm:` - Icon bumped to `h-5 w-5` on mobile, `sm:h-4 sm:w-4` on desktop - **Snapshot update** for new class strings - **ROADMAP.md** — Added mobile UX optimization details under completed milestones ```tsx // Before: fixed center, no mobile adaptation "fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-lg translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 border bg-background p-6 ..." // After: mobile-first full-screen, desktop centered "fixed inset-0 z-50 grid w-full bg-background p-4 shadow-lg duration-200", "h-[100dvh]", "sm:inset-auto sm:left-[50%] sm:top-[50%] sm:translate-x-[-50%] sm:translate-y-[-50%]", "sm:max-w-lg sm:h-auto sm:max-h-[90vh] sm:rounded-lg sm:border sm:p-6", ``` ### Already implemented (verified, no changes needed) | Item | Status | |------|--------| | `MobileDialogContent` + ModalForm flex layout (sticky header/footer) | ✅ | | Skeleton loading replaces spinner | ✅ | | Grid forced 1-col on mobile (`md:grid-cols-2` breakpoint) | ✅ | | Date/DateTime native inputs (`type="date"`, `type="datetime-local"`) | ✅ | | Form sections via `ModalFormSectionConfig` | ✅ |
Original prompt ---- *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* [Mobile UX] 优化移动端 ModalForm 弹窗的表单交互和布局 ### 背景 在移动端 "Create Event" 类型弹窗中，表单存在多处可优化体验：如弹窗没有全屏覆盖、主操作按钮易被内容遮挡、部分字段（如日期）缺乏原生输入体验等。 #### 主要问题 1. **Modal 未能在移动端自适应全屏**，顶部和底部空间浪费，主操作区常被遮挡。 2. **操作按钮未固顶到底部**，填写较多内容时，需滚动到页面底部才可操作，易导致误操作流失。 3. **表单布局响应式不足**，部分字段在移动端仍排成多列，建议小屏下强制一列。 4. **关闭按钮触控区过小**，不易点击，需调整为大于 44×44px。 5. **日期等字段应启用移动原生输入控件**，如 ``，提升录入效率。 6. **缺失渐进���载骨架**，表单加载时应显示骨架屏提升感知速度，减少首屏空白。 7. **缺乏字段分组的视觉层次**，对于字段众多的表单建议分组+标题，方便查找与填写。 ### 优化建议与实施点： - [ ] 修改 DialogContent 组件，使其在小屏下使用 `inset-0 h-[100dvh]` 并顶部/底部圆角移至 sm 断点。 - [ ] ModalForm 结构调整为 flex 列，Header（sticky）+ 滚动区域 + Footer（sticky 按钮区）。 - [ ] 核查/调整自动布局 grid-class 响应断点，使 2 列及以上在 md 尺寸及以上生效，小屏一律单列。 - [ ] 调整关闭按钮最小尺寸，确保易用性和可达性。 - [ ] 校正 field 渲染逻辑，使日期时间字段在移动端优先使用原生控件。 - [ ] 加入表单骨架 loading UI，避免首屏加载抖动。 - [ ] 推荐事件类表单采用分组/section，提高视觉与操作逻辑。 ### 影响组件及文件 - packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx - packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx - packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx - packages/fields/src/index.tsx - apps/console/src/App.tsx --- **参考 ROADMAP 相关目标 & 已完成项：** - [x] Full-screen modal on mobile: `h-[100dvh] sm:h-auto sm:max-h-[90vh]` - Let me provide a comprehensive UX optimization analysis of this "Create Event" modal form on mobile. --- ## 📱 "Create Event" ModalForm Mobile UX Optimization Analysis Based on the screenshot from `demo.objectui.org` and deep analysis of the codebase, I've identified **8 optimization areas** across 3 layers: **DialogContent (primitives)**, **ModalForm (plugin)**, and **Form Renderer (components)**. --- ### 🔍 Issue Summary | # | Issue | Severity | Layer | |---|-------|----------|-------| | 1 | Modal not full-screen on mobile (wasted viewport space) | 🔴 High | `dialog.tsx` + `ModalForm.tsx` | | 2 | No sticky footer for action buttons (Cancel/Save Record) | 🔴 High | `ModalForm.tsx` | | 3 | Fields don't collapse to 1-column on narrow screens | 🟡 Medium | `ModalForm.tsx` auto-layout | | 4 | Close button (×) touch target too small | 🟡 Medium | `dialog.tsx` | | 5 | No visual separation between field groups | 🟢 Low | `ModalForm.tsx` render | | 6 | Date/DateTime fields lack native mobile pickers | 🟡 Medium | Field renderers | | 7 | Participants (Lookup) search input not mobile-optimized | 🟡 Medium | Lookup field | | 8 | Loading skeleton missing for better perceived performance | 🟢 Low | `ModalForm.tsx` | --- ### 1. 🔴 Modal Should Be Full-Screen on Mobile **Current state:** The `DialogContent` uses a centered `fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] translate` positioning with `max-w-lg`, which wastes significant viewport space on small screens.
